WITH qualified_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            cu.cust_city,
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
            SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
        FROM sales s
        JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
        JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
        JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
        WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
          AND s.promo_id = 999
          AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
        GROUP BY cu.cust_city
    ) city_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 > 0
      AND (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019 >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cu.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND cu.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY cu.cust_city, p.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_desc,
        SUM(product_sales) as product_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_desc
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_desc,
        product_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_desc ORDER BY product_sales DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_desc) as cnt
    FROM product_sales_agg
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_desc,
        product_sales
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE rn <= cnt * 0.20
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_quarter_desc,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        t2.prod_id,
        t2.calendar_quarter_desc,
        t2.product_sales / pt.total_sales as share
    FROM top_20_percent t2
    JOIN product_totals pt ON t2.prod_id = pt.prod_id AND t2.calendar_quarter_desc = pt.calendar_quarter_desc
),
share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        share_2020 - share_2019 as share_change
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            p1.prod_id,
            p1.share as share_2019,
            p2.share as share_2020
        FROM product_shares p1
        JOIN product_shares p2 ON p1.prod_id = p2.prod_id
        WHERE p1.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04'
          AND p2.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04'
    )
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_change
FROM share_change
ORDER BY share_change DESC
